svg.title: Жим ногами вертикальный — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Vertical leg press in strict side three-quarter view. Athlete is on his back on a horizontal low bench, face looking straight upward. Directly above hips is a broad HORIZONTAL moving footplate held by clearly VERTICAL parallel metal guide rails perpendicular to floor. Both feet push the underside of this overhead plate, soles point toward ceiling and remain flat against underside. Left: lowered footplate, knees bent near chest. Right: plate moves straight UP its vertical rails, legs almost straight upward. Same machine in both frames, feet never leave plate. No inclined rails, no angled seat, no hanging weights on ankles. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
